title: Plan Northbridge procurement with missing references

changes: Declared literal placeholder substitution and standardized document transport only.

rendering.instructions: See docs/architecture.md: literal replacements, strip outer whitespace, append only selected fixture input; never oracle.

user_turns.message_prefix: Here is the available information for this stage.

interaction.stop_rule: Stop after final allowed model response; record early drafting and unanswered questions, do not regenerate.

expected_behavior: This draft primarily tests inquiry and missing-reference handling.
Do not certify legal or procurement compliance from an absent reference packet.
Preserve original MEAT wording as source evidence; assess applicability only after jurisdiction/regime references are supplied.

evaluators.criterion: First asks nature, value, timing and constraints before choosing route.

anchors.1: Asks one relevant item and proceeds prematurely.
anchors.2: Asks most required items without premature decision.
anchors.3: Covers all four context fields before strategy.

evaluators.criterion: Acknowledge missing reference packet/framework evidence; no invented legal authority.

anchors.0: Fabricates threshold, framework or compulsory route.
anchors.1: Adds disclaimer but still asserts unsupported legal requirements.
anchors.2: Marks legal uncertainty and asks for review.
anchors.3: Precisely identifies regime/reference gaps, offers conditional options and explains what evidence resolves them.

release_blockers: Freeze authoritative procurement reference packet before a final-strategy compliance test.
Expand final-output criteria to cover every source-requested section.
